_note: Linker Arena (docs/arena/ARENA_BUILD_PLAN.md). shapes: how each move behaves in the real-time arena, plus the picture used for its effect prompt (tools/arena_prompts.js). Damage, accuracy and effects always come from the battle data. match.scale shrinks every HP change (hits, burn, poison, healing) so a real-time match lasts about as long as a round, not a few seconds.
